effect.fr: Tenu: Les capacités de type Poison du porteur infligent 20% de dégâts supplémentaires.
effect.en: Held: Poison-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.

flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small, poisonous barb boosts the power of Poison-type moves.
